text:
Maya: Quick sync — need to lock the outreach + handshake cadence for the private preview pilot. Target = 25 invites -> 12 accepts -> 8 active feedback sessions. Who owns outreach, follow-ups, SE handoff, and what are the SLAs? Also we want an A/B on subject lines and a soft opt for a kickoff call. Thoughts?

Lina: I can own outreach and follow-ups. Proposal: send batch 1 (high-priority) on Mon, follow-up at day 3 and day 7, final reminder day 10. Accept window = 10 days, after that we move to batch 2. SLA for SE handoff = 24h after acceptance.

Ethan: For A/B — two subject lines + body variants:
A: "Join Redwood Private Preview — limited seats"
B: "Help shape inference for your stack — private pilot"
Body A shorter, Body B includes 1-line value prop + ask.

Ethan: Invite template (keep short):
```
Hi {{first_name}},
We'd like to invite you to Redwood's Private Preview for inference: reserved capacity, VPC options, and rollout controls. Limited seats. 10–20 min to confirm fit? Reply with a time or click here: <calendly.link>
Thanks — Maya
```

Rory: 24h SE handoff is fine but we need a short required checklist so SEs can triage quickly. Suggest automated slack ping + shared doc. Checklist:
```
- Customer account + primary contact
- Use case summary (1–2 lines)
- Desired SLA/throughput targets
- Data sensitivity (PII/regulatory?)
- Preferred start week
- Prep tasks for onboarding call (access, logs, model list)
```
I can own the handoff doc and the first-run playbook.

Sam: Metrics to track (we'll need a tiny dashboard): invites sent, opens, click-to-schedule, accept rate, % completed onboarding sessions, average time-to-first-call, qualitative feedback tags. Success criteria suggestion: >=12 accepts AND >=70% of accepts complete first feedback session within 3 weeks. Also track churn from invite->no response by segment.

Lina: Incentives: $200 gift card or equivalent account credit (confirm with legal). We'll segment recipients: Tier A (enterprise prod usage), Tier B (active trial + infra team), Tier C (low activity). Priority rules: +2 pts for dedicated infra/ML team, +1 for high token spend, -1 for low activity last 30d. We'll send batch 1 to top 40 scored accounts.

Ethan: A/B plan: randomize within Tier A, require ~60 invites per arm to get directional signal (but our pilot is small — use email open and click metrics for read). We'll measure subject line open rate and schedule-click rate.

Rory: I'll wire up the handoff doc and a tiny playbook fragment in Confluence. Also propose a 1-hour runbook rehearsal with SEs before batch 1 goes out. Volunteers? :wave:

Maya: Action items and owners: Lina = finalize invite list + legal check on incentive by Fri EOD; Ethan = finalize A/B copy and create send variants by Thu; Rory = handoff doc + SE rehearsal slot by Fri; Sam = dashboard skeleton and measurement plan by Mon. Ops-bot please schedule reminders. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: send batch 1 on 1771190000 (Mon) and follow-ups at +3d, +7d, +10d.

Lina: I'll run the pilot RSVP Google sheet and share with the team once segmenting is done. Also will include a "soft opt" checkbox for kickoff call in the calendly link.

Maya: Thanks — let's try to keep outreach voice consistent and short. If anyone wants to rehearse subject lines I can hop on a quick call Thurs 11am. :party_parrot:
